selection: Hash rank seed|episode selects4 eligible new episodes per scene. Eligibility requires each color lift_table and lift_drawer interval plus2 place_in_drawer intervals. Rank seed|segment chooses1 of each color/location and2 place intervals. Lift phase fractions0,1/3,2/3,1; place0,1/2,1; floor to frame, deduplicate without replacement. No outcome or model prediction is read for new sources.
episode_split: Old4 stay train_candidate because inspected. New4 per scene: two smallest seed|split hashes validation_candidate, remainingtwo train_candidate. All original and derived records inherit root split; no frame leakage. C/D absent. No training authorized.
old_retest: 4 per original episode: first distinct source frame in prior H-positive, In-positive, all-six-negative, unknown classes; missing category uses first remaining frame. Uses sealed prior labels for descriptive change analysis only, not new episode selection.
controller: Same recorded absolute TCP xyz/euler and robot_obs[-1] reissued through native apply_action before steps1,9,...89;12 control periods,8 native physics ticks each; scene.step every8. No action trajectory replay. Joint/motor targets audited.
initialization: fresh native world each source once; restore recorded state and zero unrecorded movable-object velocities; no env.reset implicit tick
strict_labels: Frozen native Holding and In unchanged; same per-tick confidence .005/.015N and certain support normal .55 as previous resimulation
stable_labels: Every tick32..96 must have same value as96, valid native label and unambiguous per-tick force evidence. Otherwise unknown.
force_stability: Holding positive additionally requires coefficient of variation(population std/mean)<=0.25 for each finger-family TOTAL positive normal force across all65 ticks. In positive additionally requires at least one same certain contained object-to-drawer path at every tick, and CV<=0.25 of total certain upward force on each body-to-body edge across all65 ticks. Certain edges use force>=.015N,nz>=.55,gap<=.003. No force-variation constraint for negatives beyond all-tick confident negative evidence.
supplementary_table_state: Diagnostic only: native table base link -1 supports object with certain upward contact at all65ticks and final Holding/In both reliable false; not a new learned predicate. Empty hand requires all3 Holding reliable false.
basic_coverage_check: Descriptive target: per split and color Holding positive and negative each represented by>=2 distinct episodes; separately report In positive/negative and tabletop-negative episodes without claiming formal acceptance. No adaptive replenishment.
drift: Record all object translations/rotations and TCP pose drift each step; report regardless of outcome. No drift-based posthoc filtering.
failure_policy: Each frozen initialization once. Technical failure saves partial state and stops whole run without retry; physical failure/unstable/unknown is recorded and next frozen initialization continues.
